hardware_target: 4 x H100 80GB; deployment estimates require a model smoke
schedule: Run embedding first, then generation and adjudication in separate stages; optional two TP=2 services after memory measurement.

generator.selection_reason: Existing local weights and multilingual structured instruction following. Use bounded evidence packets rather than maximal advertised context.

judge.selection_reason: A separately trained model family for evidence adjudication; disagreement is sent to review. Cross-family judging does not remove correlated errors. Weights are not downloaded automatically.

retriever.selection_reason: Preserves the agreed candidate-pool retriever. Encoding length is explicit and truncation must be audited.

audit_retriever.selection_reason: Optional independent dense candidate mining alongside lexical search; never silently replaces KaLM in official pools.

validation_boundary: Official model cards and local configuration inspected. No deployment throughput or GPU completion claimed. Pin weight identity when actually serving.
